title: I Found the Golden Event Goose Using Claude
author: Ok-Variation3247

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: you've rebuilt selling insurance, which is fine as long as you know that's what you're holding. at 95 cents you make 5 and lose 95, so one flip eats 19 wins, and your 25 day sample already has one loss in it. WTI stays inside a 3 to 5 percent band until the day it doesn't, and those days arrive on headlines that land exactly while you're waiting for the sentiment to be clear. size it like an insurance seller, not like found money, and the goose lives longer.

replies.author: BroomClstBillionaire
replies.body: This is assuming it's just one trade per day. If it's one loss across 25 Days, but 100 trades per day, that's a higher success rate

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: more trades a day doesn't change the per trade math, it changes how many are open when the one bad headline lands. at 95 cents, 100 positions on the same event lose together, so one loss in 25 days is one loss across 100 lots. run it on paper with the real daily count first, that's what I built Quantradin to show. quantradin.com

replies.author: Ok-Variation3247
replies.body: Its 1 trade per day WTI/OIL. I backtested before doing forward testing with real money. So far so good - check it out at [consistentpredictions.com](http://consistentpredictions.com)

replies.author: Ok-Variation3247
replies.body: That's correct - big risk but at a 98% probability to land in your favor. The one day that went against me was a black swan event. I've since built a news catalyst gate for the trade.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: the gate catches scheduled news like the Wednesday EIA number, it can't see a 3am headline. and at 95 cents your breakeven is 95%, so 98% leaves about 3 cents a contract. one extra bad day every 30 trades and it's gone.

replies.author: Ok-Variation3247
replies.body: WTI goes live at midnight but my scanners and gates kick in 9am - buy after that window and the Event closes daily at 2:30pm EST. So we’re buying after overseas news has been digested by the market.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: so the 9am gate is doing the job of letting overseas news settle. have you looked at the entries that would have fired before 9? if those lose on paper, the gate is real and not just a lucky window.

replies.author: Ok-Variation3247
replies.body: I have seen those losses - the gate is definitely real.
